notes: BUB1B compound het (p.Leu737Ter PATHOGENIC + p.Asn1002Lys absent-from-gnomAD missense, SIFT/PolyPhen damaging). Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (AR): rhabdomyosarcoma + Wilms predisposition, severe IUGR, postnatal growth failure. Matches 6/8 HPO terms. Prediction only - phase and PCS/MVA karyotype confirmation still pending.

SLC34A1 p.Ala133Val het, SIFT deleterious, ClinVar conflicting, AF 1.0%. Only rare damaging hit across 47-gene renal tubulopathy panel; candidate modifier for the nephrocalcinosis not explained by BUB1B. Monoallelic effect only - insufficient alone.

ADAMTS1 two rare frameshifts (p.Glu225LeufsTer13, p.Thr220ArgfsTer76), both AF 8.8e-05. 8 bp apart with near-identical AD - almost certainly same-haplotype/complex-indel artifact, not true compound het. Low confidence.
BUB1B p.Asn1002Lys considered alone (if p.Leu737Ter proves to be in cis or a false call). Absent from gnomAD, PolyPhen 0.997. Monoallelic BUB1B is not disease-causing - listed only for completeness.
ATM p.Ser978Pro het, AF 0.5%, missense. ATM heterozygosity is a modest cancer-risk modifier and relevant to radiotherapy planning for the rhabdomyosarcoma. Does not explain growth/renal phenotype.

PEX5 homozygous 45 bp deletion called as splice_donor, but coordinates are deep intronic (c.147+77_147+121del) and depth is low (DP 10, GQ 37). Zellweger spectrum would fit FTT/growth failure - but this is most likely a mis-annotated low-quality indel. Requires manual review before any action.

PRSS1 p.Ala16Val, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic for hereditary pancreatitis. AD 29/5 (VAF 0.15) in a highly paralogous locus - likely mismapping artifact. Verify on IGV before reporting; if real, pancreatitis surveillance.
GNRHR p.Arg139His het, ClinVar Pathogenic for AR hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 7. Carrier state only (no second allele found). Relevant to future pubertal assessment given short stature.
FLG p.Arg2447Ter het, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic. Common loss-of-function allele conferring ichthyosis vulgaris / atopic dermatitis risk. Unrelated to primary presentation.
MC3R p.Met210ValfsTer101 het, AF 2.1e-04. MC3R disruption is linked to altered growth and pubertal timing; heterozygous effect is weak. Possible minor contributor to failure to thrive.
